text.tspan: Worker pod · IRSA in worker only · no ingress · egress DNS + 443
Parsers in a credential-free container; egress shared
Stale-header anomalies are warnings, not outcomes
Messages checked against job records; IAM per prefix
Worker egress: TCP 443 to any internet host
Whole-load capped; in-process tile re-read remains
Failed send marks failed; crashes, deadline open
LAS and E57 allocations bounded by file size
Unauthenticated API: now Cognito sign-in at the ALB
Per-user access by default: each user reaches their own jobs
POST /api/models removed; registry takes models bucket only
Account-wide S3 BPA: opt-in, never deleted
Add-ons have their IRSA roles; credentials checked
Fluent Bit runs on GPU nodes
Default-deny and egress rules on every pod
PLY textures, E57 DTDs and format mismatch refused
HSTS sent; client https check open
CSRF / DNS rebinding: SPA header, host allowlist
Users' email addresses held in Cognito
Ingress or Service write can take sign-in off a rule
Password-only sign-in unless MFA is required
Signed ALB claims verified: signer, client, pool, expiry

no ALB and no Cognito. Users and scripts run kubectl port-forward through the EKS API, authorised by IAM,
an EKS access entry and a namespaced Role; access is shared. nginx proxies /api only with the SPA header and a localhost Host (T31, T49, T69).
